about: Maple Ridge lies on the north shore of the Fraser River in Metro Vancouver’s eastern suburbs, between Pitt Meadows and Mission. The historic town centre of Haney sits above the river, with suburban neighbourhoods climbing toward Golden Ears Provincial Park. Logging, river industry, and commuting into Vancouver all still show in local life. About 91,000 people live in Maple Ridge.
seoSummary: Fraser River suburb at the foot of Golden Ears Provincial Park, east of Pitt Meadows.
